# Confluence Checklist

Before any non-Wait decision, run this list. If any critical item fails → Wait.

- [ ] At least N higher-ranked seats agree on direction (desk default: top 3)
- [ ] No active protective veto / Law lockdown
- [ ] Horizon is stated and matches the question
- [ ] Sample size / evidence for the ranking is not still “building”
- [ ] Book / market conditions are not chalk or empty (if relevant)
- [ ] I can write one sentence of synthesis without inventing conviction

**If the list fails, the correct output is Wait.**  
A clean Wait is a process win. Log it.
